scope: Independent frozen pre-event synthetic validator evaluation, host CPU; no actions, training, fine-tuning, model/prompt changes or downloads.
freeze_condition: Dataset and generator fixed before root edits v0.8 validator; root does not inspect request text until candidate source is locked.
contract: One immediate reviewed focus start/resume, pause or focus status; Clock alarm at one valid clock-only time or timer; one approved Settings/Calculator/Clock app. Friendly Mira/polite wrappers and bounded integer English/digit numeric slots. Focus/timer duration 1 second to 120 minutes; hours, signed/fractional/multiple durations unsupported. Alarm hours/minutes may be digit-colon or integer English hour/minute with AM/PM. No dates, recurrence, commands in quotations/reported statements, capability/information questions, conditions, negation, destructive/unsupported actions, multi-action or unsupported extra qualifiers. Ordinary polite suffixes are supported.
oracle_intent: Nearest domain intent for unsupported in-domain commands deliberately tests original-text rejection even when the model proposes that action; oracle unknown only for unrelated unsupported commands. This is validator ceiling evaluation, not overall raw semantic intent accuracy.
score: Exact (kind,hour,minute,seconds); supported correct coverage, false abstentions, wrong accepted slots/action, unsupported false accepts, precision/coverage and family counts. Wrong accepted supported proposal is a failure even if benign. No action execution or outcome claims.
paths: All raw requests, model outputs, gate outputs and compiled code in ignored build/. Tracked source/aggregate/manifests only.
comparison: Generate model output once using unchanged existing LocalModel JNI CPU prompt/context1024/threads4; feed identical raw original request to separately compiled v0.7 and frozen v0.8 Java validators. Evaluate both generated model intents and oracle domain intents. No adaptive prompt/parser/data repair after seeing results.
